failure.guard: pending is None or pending.state == done

installed_contract.review_state: Fresh POST authorization:review is canonical; saves new reviewed request/revision after response. Does not issue or recover.
installed_contract.submitted_state: authorization_review delegates authorize; may recover/issue. Must remain refused by review-only helper.
installed_contract.unknown_state: Refuse at helper boundary; no automatic recovery or guessed settlement.

minimal_remedy: Separate pinned successor/overlay helper may permit only exact historical review snapshot with valid revision and expected scope, then one canonical CLI review. Preserve failed frozen W17 artifacts and controller fault; no manual checkpoint mutation, replay, fake settlement or grant issuance without exact new review selection.
limits: Source/predicate diagnosis and exact metadata only; no terminal receipt status, current grant availability or future recovery success inferred.
